target.statement: Annual seasonal strength (Wang-Smith-Hyndman) exceeds weekly seasonal strength for 96.8% of institutions (median annual strength 0.83 vs weekly medians 0.34-0.49), computed on the n_bytes metric at 1-day aggregation.

compute.basis: Downloading only the 285 institution 1-day CSVs (small subset of the 141 GB archive) plus a straightforward STL/seasonal-strength computation per series; the main cost is download and install time, not compute.

blockers: Full Zenodo archive is 141 GB compressed / 473.7 GB uncompressed, so must selectively fetch only the institutions/agg_1_day files
Seasonal-strength implementation (Wang-Smith-Hyndman) is not provided as a script; agent must write it
title: CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection
